description: Google Play app reviews API for AI agents: send an Android package name or a Google Play app URL and get up to 200 reviews as JSON: rating, text, date, app version, language and helpful votes. Sort by newest, relevance or rating and filter by stars. Reviewer names and photos are not returned. An app with no reviews is not charged.

app.description: an Android package name (e.g. com.spotify.music) or a Google Play app URL (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.spotify.music)

limit.description: number of reviews wanted, 1 to 200 (default 20). A larger value is lowered to 200 and 0 or a negative one means the default; the quote follows the value used.

rating.description: keep only reviews with this many stars (1 to 5); omit for all

name: google-play-reviews
title: Google Play reviews of an Android app
